question: According to the information received by the end of 2023, who among the following is the Governor of Telangana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamilisai Sundararajan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tamilisai Sundararajan** is the current Governor of Telangana as of the end of 2023.
 
• She was appointed as the Governor of Telangana on September 1, 2019.
 
• Prior to her appointment as Governor, Tamilisai Sundararajan was the President of the Tamil Nadu BJP unit.
 
• She is the first woman to hold the office of Governor of Telangana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Governor is the constitutional head of the state and is appointed by the President of India.
 
• The Governor's role includes overseeing the functioning of the state government and ensuring that it acts in accordance with the Constitution of India.
 
• The Governor also has the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment to individuals convicted of offenses against state laws.
 
• In the event of a constitutional crisis, the Governor can assume greater executive powers and may dissolve the state legislative assembly.
 
• Tamilisai Sundararajan has a medical background and holds an MBBS degree along with a specialization in Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
